# Copilot instructions for SpotifAI

Start here. The deep references live under `docs/` — only the load-bearing rules are below.

## What this repo is

A React/Express PWA that streams Spotify with AI-DJ chatter generated by Google Gemini. See [docs/architecture.md](../docs/architecture.md) for the system map and the four critical flows (OAuth, session start, per-track chatter, telemetry).

## Read these before making non-trivial changes

| Touching… | Read first |
|---|---|
| client React/Redux | [docs/architecture.md](../docs/architecture.md) (Repository layout + Session start flow), [docs/conventions.md](../docs/conventions.md) |
| client player / Media Session / audio | [client/Components/player/PlayerProvider.jsx](../client/Components/player/PlayerProvider.jsx) — single source of truth for playback + DJ overlay + ducking + WakeLock |
| server route | [server/app.js](../server/app.js), [docs/conventions.md](../docs/conventions.md) "Express route shape" |

| LLM or TTS provider | [server/services/llm/index.js](../server/services/llm/index.js), [server/services/tts/index.js](../server/services/tts/index.js) — provider-pluggable |

## Rules

### Code style
- **Default to no comments.** Add one only when the *why* is non-obvious. One short line max. See [docs/conventions.md](../docs/conventions.md#comments).
- **No over-engineering.** Don't add features, abstractions, or error-handling beyond what's asked. Trust internal contracts.
- **Match the existing route / logging / Redux patterns exactly.** See [docs/conventions.md](../docs/conventions.md). Don't introduce a new pattern unless asked.

### Privacy + logging
- **Never log a raw email or Spotify token.** Hash emails via [server/services/utl/hashUserId.js](../server/services/utl/hashUserId.js); log `userIdHash`.
- **Never `console.*` in `server/`** — use Pino from [server/services/logger.js](../server/services/logger.js). Test code and scripts are exempt.
- **Structured fields, not interpolation.** `logger.info({ djId, ms }, 'session.start')`, not `logger.info(`session.start took ${ms}ms`)`.

### Safety
- **No `npm install`, `git push`, `azd up`, or destructive scripts without explicit user OK.**
- **Don't reset the Postgres container** (`Postgres: Reset` task). It destroys all local data.
- **Don't bypass safety checks** (`--no-verify`, `--force`) as a shortcut.
- When unsure whether an action is destructive, ask.

### Tooling
- **Prefer the VS Code task names** for dev workflow: `Start Dev`, `Postgres: Up (Docker)`, `Chrome: Open Debug`. See [docs/local-development.md](../docs/local-development.md#vs-code-tasks-the-right-way-to-start).
- Dev URL is **`http://127.0.0.1:3000`** — not `localhost`. Spotify OAuth fails on the wrong host.
- To verify a change: run `Start Dev`, exercise the affected flow in the browser, then `npm run smoke` for the seed-asset sanity check.

### When you change behavior, also update the docs
File-to-doc map lives in [docs/conventions.md](../docs/conventions.md#when-changing-these-files-also-update). Don't update docs reflexively — only when the change makes the doc wrong.

## Things this codebase intentionally does

These can look like bugs at first glance but are correct:

- **Sequelize `sync({ alter: true })` on every boot.** No migration tool; new models create tables, column tweaks alter. See [server/db/seed.js](../server/db/seed.js).
- **Intro audio cache key includes `personaVersion` AND `promptVersion`.** Editing either forks the cache and old blobs are naturally orphaned. Don't write a manual cache-bust step.
- **`UserIntroPlayed` suppresses the intro on the second listen.** This is the design — the intro's purposes (fill cold-start time + explain the station) are satisfied after one play.
- **Static images stay on disk; only generated audio goes to blob.** Don't migrate `public/images/**` to blob.
- **No CDN in front of blob.** Long `Cache-Control` is enough at our scale. Revisit only if egress becomes visible.
- **`useStartSession` does NOT abort on consumer unmount.** Switching tabs mid-intro must not cut the DJ off.
- **`/healthz` returns 200 unconditionally.** The DB check lives in `/readyz` so the App Service health probe doesn't hammer Postgres every minute.

## Things to ask the user about, never assume

- Anything that costs money (TTS regenerations, image generations, deploys).
- Anything that touches Azure resources.
- Anything that mutates the production DB.
- Changing the DJ roster or persona files.
